data.one_liner: Genkit Dart plugin for local AI through llamadart: GGUF, LiteRT-LM, chat, tool calling, and embeddings
data.what_it_does: Runs local LLMs and on-device AI in Genkit Dart and Flutter applications. Supports GGUF and LiteRT-LM models for offline chat, token streaming, tool calling, structured JSON output, embeddings, batch transcription, speech synthesis, and image generation.
use_when: You need offline, on-device AI capabilities in a Dart or Flutter application.
You want to use Genkit with local GGUF models or LiteRT-LM bundles via llamadart.
avoid_when: You rely entirely on cloud-based LLM APIs and have no need for local on-device inference.
Your target environment lacks support for native runtimes and companions.
strengths: Enables completely offline local AI inference in application processes.
Supports chat, streaming, tool calling, structured JSON output, embeddings, and media tasks.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific companion runtimes and configuration (e.g., Apple companions for iOS/macOS).
Feature support heavily depends on the loaded model and backend runtime.
data.setup_notes: Requires Dart 3.12+, Genkit 1.x, and llamadart 0.19.x. Flutter apps need runtime companion packages like llamadart_llama_cpp_flutter or llamadart_litert_lm_flutter, with specific OS version requirements.

alternatives.name: firebase_ai
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose firebase_ai if you prefer using cloud-hosted Gemini models via Firebase rather than running local models on-device.

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose tflite_flutter if you want to run custom TensorFlow Lite models directly without Genkit overhead.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose llamadart directly if you want raw llama.cpp bindings without the Genkit abstraction layer.
